newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan refiner to shut No.3 cracker, restarts No.4.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan refiner to shut No.3 cracker, restarts No.4.

text.p: Taiwan's state monopoly Chinese Petroleum Corp will shut its No.3 naphtha cracker on Wednesday for 14 days of maintenance and has restarted its No.4 cracker after a 60-day service shutdown, executives said.
"The No.3 naphtha cracker will be down for two weeks, but all product supplies will remain normal as the No.4 cracker is back on line now," a company official said on Friday.
Sources at the monopoly said the No.3 cracker's air condenser would be adjusted or replaced during the shutdown.
The No.4 cracker was closed on May 2 for 60 days of routine annual service, the official said.
The No.3 cracker has annual production capacity of 230,000 tonnes of ethylene while No.4 can produce 385,000 tonnes.
Its No.5 cracker can make 400,000 tonnes of ethylene.
Its No.1 cracker was closed in 1990 and No.2 plant in April 1994.
